horoscope: Social and learning opportunities are emerging, dear Aries, but it’s important today that you don’t go too far, and this is especially so for adding new projects or responsibilities to your life. Without even knowing it, you could be misleading others simply because you want to do more than you’re realistically able to manage. Letting things flow and keeping everything moderate are the keys to staying evenly, naturally happy today. Tomorrow, both Mercury and Venus will end their retrogrades, which can help clarify many things in your life, particularly related to relationships and finances, but during the shift,   it's best to wait and see.

There is a stronger emphasis on learning and communicating today, dear Taurus, but there may be some distractions or feelings of unrest, as you could feel that you’re in the dark about what’s truly going on. This is temporary. Tomorrow, both your ruler, Venus, and communication planet, Mercury, will end their retrograde cycles, and clarity is on its way. Still, excitement can fill your mind with fresh new ideas today. Write down whatever you don’t communicate or put into motion, because it’s an excellent time for new insights. Keep in mind, however, that launching new projects is not a good idea quite yet. Be an intelligent observer.

Flexibility will be your primary key to success right now, dear Gemini, as important shifts are occurring that are positive but temporarily disorienting. Try to embrace differences and changes as opportunities for you or for a relationship to grow. Circumstances may be such that you question a learning path or interest. If your life has become too busy with inconsequential things, you'll be feeling that now. Staying busy and active makes sense now. As long as you avoid making too-big promises, you’ll do well today as an observer.

It’s a good time for getting comfortable and engaging in some form of self-pampering if possible, dear Cancer, but avoid going overboard if you know you’ll regret it later. Circumstances may require you to let go of certain possessions or even attitudes toward business and money matters to move forward. In fact, while the week holds somewhat confusing energy overall, you're in good shape to better understand your comfort needs and wants and your financial affairs. Keep things simple and moderate, and learn how to discern between sincere desire and desire that stems from inner discontent.

Relationships require more sensitivity than usual right now, dear Leo. In truth, you are looking for a little more meaning in your life. Recognize and honor this need for the best results. Learning about yourself and how to express yourself are important to you now, and you want others to give you this freedom. However, there could be a bit of a blow to the ego if you are pushing too hard for your own agenda. The need to pay some homage to a partnership or partner may arise. On this day before two important retrograde cycles end, it's a fine time for light chatting and exchanging information, but not so strong for major launches or decisions.

Avoid investing too much in the promises and responses of others today, dear Virgo, since we tend to be a bit impractical for now. The key to balance is taking charge of your own happiness instead of waiting for someone else to make you happy. It's a little easier than usual to put your emotional needs first and to put behind you something that's been weighing you down. Tomorrow, both your planetary ruler, Mercury, and Venus end their retrograde cycles on the same day! These shifts should help clarify some things, particularly money and personal projects for you. Still, on the days of the shifts, it's better to wait and see, as things are changing and evolving.

It’s important not to look outside of yourself for happiness and satisfaction today, dear Libra, as people around you can be enthusiastic but may not be consistent. Taming expectations doesn’t mean expecting less than respect. It means that you’ll be better off giving everyone space and allowing events to unfold naturally. You may wonder whether a friendship or connection to a group is helping you move forward and grow. You may need to swallow your pride for the sake of a relationship you want to keep.

There can be some tendency to overdo things today, dear Scorpio, and it will be important not to make promises that seem okay right now, but that later turn into aggravations or burdens. You may want to avoid buying on credit or lending/borrowing too much today, as you’re temporarily short-sighted. Taming excessiveness keeps you in an even, smooth frame of mind. You might be evaluating a particular project, plan, or long-term goal today, and your focus is on what's best for you. However, with both Mercury and Venus ending their retrograde cycles tomorrow, it's a time of shifts, and it's best to wait and see on important matters. Information will likely unclog as you move ahead, helping clarify things.

There can be a tendency to overdo things today, dear Sagittarius, particularly related to sharing and learning. You may feel you can do more than is reasonable, largely because of a good mood. It's best to aim to be conscious of what you are doing, not simply reacting to pressure from others and circumstances. Take the time to learn what you truly want. Watch for rash decisions, as this is a time of shifts. Tomorrow, Mercury and Venus will end their retrogrades, and things will move forward more smoothly. However, during the shift, if you haven't decided on an important matter yet, then you shouldn't push yourself to make a decision in the next couple of days.

This can be a good day for discovering something new about a special person in your life, dear Capricorn. It's best to avoid expecting too much from regular things and people with Jupiter prominent today. You may be tempted to dream up exciting plans, but you might lose motivation or later find they aren't plausible. Sticking to the tried and true may be the safest on this day before two important shifts: Mercury and Venus will end their retrograde cycles tomorrow, bringing more clarity to your life, especially your career and friendships. For now, however, you may feel somewhat in the dark, so aim to wait and see.

Try to be patient even if you don’t feel you’re moving ahead fast enough, dear Aquarius. Tomorrow, both Mercury and Venus will end their retrograde cycles, and clarity will begin to come for you, particularly with career, life goals, and education matters. However, during the shift today and tomorrow, you could feel that some things are in limbo. Also, it's best not to make major decisions until you have more information. In your relationships, intellectual companionship is emphasized now. Today, the need to entertain others' ideas and input is especially strong.

Matters of the heart come to the fore today, dear Pisces, although there can be some complications with plans. Spending may not be wise today, as you’re inclined to go overboard. You might say or promise a little too much, and even if your intentions are good, once your enthusiasm fades, you may not be up to the task. On this day before Venus and Mercury end their retrogrades, avoid important new endeavors or decisions, but enjoy yourself. Fortunately, you're likely to find that cooperation and support from others flow naturally right now.
